abstract: This literature review examines the current state of Red Blue vs Blue Agent using LLM and AI, in a DVWA, synthesizing findings from two key studies [1]–[2]. The retrieved papers highlight the challenges of evaluating structured plan-generation agents and the limitations of alignment methods in agentic settings. Key thematic paradigms include perception, state estimation, and sensing, as well as trajectory planning, navigation, and control. Open challenges identified in the literature include technical constraints in plan evaluation and the potential for malicious behavior in LLM agents. Proposed future research directions include integrating AdvPlan-Bench and Constitutional-Arms to address these challenges.
